MSI-H gastric intentionally blank: the STAD row is the pooled stomach intestinal-type panel median (5.0 mut/Mb, n=58, Chalmers 2017 Table 1) and cannot describe MSI-H disease. TCGA-STAD analysed the 215 tumours below 11.4 mut/Mb, 'none of which were MSI-positive', separately from 74 hypermutated tumours; Chalmers reports that in stomach adenocarcinoma MSI-High and high TMB (>20 mut/Mb) almost always co-occur. Neither source publishes an MSI-stratified gastric median, so this is an audited gap rather than an invented estimate.
